description: The expressway public data portal of Korea Expressway Corporation provides public data on South Korea's smart expressways. It offers a data search of the corporation's datasets, visualisations, a list of open APIs with authentication key issuance, analysis pages such as traffic by section, requests for new data, a use case board, FAQ and manuals, with links to the national transport information centre, V-World and the national public data portal. Coverage is national (the tolled expressway network). The portal is free to use, and its open APIs need a free authentication key; the portal publishes a public data use policy and copyright policy, which were not read in detail. Caveats: some of the corporation's data are also sold as products on the national transport data market, and detailed datasets were not opened on the day. The data support traffic flow models of the expressway network, incident and disruption analysis and capacity planning. They complement the JARTIC traffic volume data for Japan and are related to the Caltrans PeMS detector data.
